title: Git MCP server (reference implementation)
summary: The reference Git MCP server. The sources establish that it manipulates repositories on disk. The file access and code execution in AVE-2026-0005 come from flaws fixed in 2025.12.18; they are vulnerabilities recorded in that advisory, not capabilities, and are not recorded here.

evidence.note: Provides tools to read, search, and manipulate Git repositories; git_init creates repositories.

unknown.note: It returns repository content, which outsiders wrote only if the repository is untrusted. The sources name README files and issues as injection vectors in general, not as content this server returns.
Depends on which repositories it is pointed at.
